mechanism: Both drugs have CNS depressant effects; lacosamide may enhance nalmefene's sedative properties, and nalmefene's opioid antagonism could theoretically complicate seizure management in opioid-dependent patients.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation and CNS depression; ensure seizure control remains adequate; use caution if patient is opioid-dependent as nalmefene may precipitate withdrawal affecting seizure threshold.
